reference_definition: frozen strong ecological reference from parent Structural/mechanism protocol
candidate_definition: strong reference plus frozen source-decoupling / multi-hop mechanism coordinate
scoring_rule: candidate minus reference heldout log loss; negative is favourable
uncertainty_rule: predeclared block-aware uncertainty with no post-outcome resampling changes
success_rule: primary contrast must be favourable under the frozen local design and retain the predeclared direction under separate spatial transfer for a portable mechanism claim
primary_estimand: incremental heldout information for 0_to_1 colonization beyond the strong reference

lane_specific.detection_model: synthetic repeated-detection model frozen before confirmatory response
